title: 3rd Truth With The Verses Of Resurrection The Ease Of Resurrection By A Single Command

questions.question: What does Allah do to the earth with His command?
questions.answer: He gives it life again.

questions.question: What happens with one cry and one command?
questions.answer: All people and jinn are brought and made present.

questions.question: Who will be gathered with people and jinn?
questions.answer: Animals, spirit beings, and angels too.

questions.question: Where will they be brought?
questions.answer: To the place of the great gathering and the great weighing.

questions.question: How fast will resurrection and gathering happen?
questions.answer: Very fast, like a blink or even faster.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about creating one soul and creating everyone?
questions.answer: Both are equally easy for Allah.

questions.question: Does one task keep Allah from doing another task?
questions.answer: No. One task does not get in the way of another.

questions.question: What big idea do the three verses together teach?
questions.answer: Allah can bring everyone back easily and quickly.

questions.question: Why should people not think resurrection is hard for Allah?
questions.answer: Because His power makes it easy, even for all at once.

questions.question: What is brought back to life in the passage?
questions.answer: The earth.

questions.question: How many cries are needed to bring everyone?
questions.answer: Only one.

questions.question: Which two groups are named first as being brought near?
questions.answer: Men and jinn.

questions.question: What picture is used to show how quick the Hour will be?
questions.answer: The blinking of an eye.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the time needed for the resurrection and the gathering after it?
questions.answer: It takes almost no time at all.

questions.question: What does the teaching about one soul help us understand?
questions.answer: Bringing all back is as easy for Allah as bringing one back.

questions.question: Which kinds of living or unseen beings are included in the final gathering?
questions.answer: Humans, jinn, animals, spirit beings, and angels.

questions.question: If there are many different creatures, does that make it harder for Allah?
questions.answer: No, it is still easy for Him.

questions.question: By what does Allah revive the earth?
questions.answer: By His creating command.

questions.question: What will happen after the single cry?
questions.answer: Everyone will be brought forward.

questions.question: Is the gathering only for humans?
questions.answer: No. It includes jinn, animals, spirit beings, and angels too.

questions.question: What place are all these beings taken to?
questions.answer: The field of the supreme gathering and the great balance.

questions.question: What comparison shows the speed of the Hour?
questions.answer: It is compared to a quick eye blink.

questions.question: What does the passage mean when it says making all people is like making one soul?
questions.answer: Allah can create and raise all people as easily as one.

questions.question: What does the passage say about many jobs at once for Allah?
questions.answer: They do not clash or cause trouble for Him.

questions.question: Which is easier for Allah: raising one being or raising all beings?
questions.answer: They are the same in ease for Him.

questions.question: What main truth about the Last Day is being taught?
questions.answer: Allah will gather all creation swiftly and easily.

questions.question: What happens to the earth in this passage?
questions.answer: It is made alive again.

questions.question: How are all people and jinn called to the gathering?
questions.answer: With one cry and one command.

questions.question: What does “blink of an eye” help us understand?
questions.answer: That the event will happen extremely fast.

questions.question: What comes after resurrection in the passage?
questions.answer: The gathering.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah bringing one soul to life?
questions.answer: It is easy for Him.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah bringing all souls to life?
questions.answer: That is easy for Him too.

questions.question: Name two groups besides humans that will be present.
questions.answer: Jinn and angels.

questions.question: What happens when many creatures must be gathered at once?
questions.answer: Allah gathers them without any problem.

questions.question: What feeling should this passage give a believer about Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Trust that Allah can do all of this with ease.

questions.question: Who gives life back to the earth?
questions.answer: Allah.

questions.question: What is enough to bring everyone to the gathering?
questions.answer: A single cry from Allah’s command.

questions.question: Who are the first two groups named in that gathering?
questions.answer: Men and jinn.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the length of time for the Hour?
questions.answer: It is as quick as a blink, or even quicker.

questions.question: What does “as one soul” teach about Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Many and one are the same for His power.

questions.question: Which beings are gathered along with people and jinn?
questions.answer: Animals, spirit beings, and angels.

questions.question: What is the “great balance” about?
questions.answer: It is the place of weighing in the final gathering.

questions.question: What does the passage say about one concern and another concern?
questions.answer: One does not interfere with another.

questions.question: Why is the supreme gathering not difficult for Allah?
questions.answer: Because His command is enough for all of them at once.

questions.question: What does Allah do to the earth before speaking about the final gathering?
questions.answer: He brings it back to life.

questions.question: How many commands are needed to bring all to the resurrection place?
questions.answer: One command.

questions.question: What shows that the resurrection will be sudden and quick?
questions.answer: It is described as faster than or like an eye blink.

questions.question: According to the passage, what is as easy as bringing one soul to life?
questions.answer: Creating, raising, and gathering all people.

questions.question: Who will stand in the supreme gathering?
questions.answer: Humans, jinn, animals, spirit beings, and angels.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah’s power and large numbers?
questions.answer: Large numbers do not make anything harder for Him.

questions.question: What does it mean that one concern does not interfere with another?
questions.answer: Allah can do many things at the same time with no trouble.

questions.question: What two places or events are named for the Hereafter scene?
questions.answer: The field of gathering and the great balance.

questions.question: What is the main lesson of the whole passage?
questions.answer: Allah will raise and gather all creation easily, quickly, and with one command.
